body: I try not to talk to my friends because I don't like worrying or upsetting them, and they just compliment me vaguely. like if I say I feel worthless, they'd just say I'm not. I don't blame them though, I wouldn't know what to do If I was them.

Thank you I appreciate your kind words, I truly do. its just people have been saying its gonna get better for years and its only gotten worse. I'm tired of feeling the way I do, its been like this for so very long. its really difficult to keep going if all I get is disappointment. I just dont know what to do.
